resources.string: Movies and series from your own Jellyfin or Emby server
Jellyfin or Emby, on your network or online
Sign in a TV or another device using this one
No servers yet. Add your own Jellyfin or Emby server to browse and play it here. Your sign-in stays on this device.
Type your server’s address. Tuvora tries the usual ports and https or http for you.
You picked %1$s, but this server is %2$s. Continuing as %2$s.
Get a code and approve it from a device that is already signed in
Your password is used once to sign in and is never stored
Enter this code to sign in
On a device already signed in to %1$s, open Quick Connect and enter this code. On Jellyfin: Settings, then Quick Connect.
Your password is sent to the server once and not saved. Only the sign-in it returns is kept, on this device.
That does not look like a server address.
Something answered at that address, but it is not a Jellyfin or Emby server.
Could not reach the server. Check the address, the port and that the server is on.
Quick Connect did not finish. It may be turned off on the server.
Could not sign in. Try again in a moment.
This address now belongs to a different server than the one you added. Remove the old entry and add the new one.
The sign-in could not be stored securely on this device.
This server reported an identity Tuvora cannot use.

This server’s certificate was not issued by an authority your device trusts (a self-signed or private certificate). If this fingerprint matches your server, trust it. Tuvora will warn you if it ever changes.
This server is no longer on your account.
This device’s sign-in ended (the server refused it). Sign in again to keep using this server.
This server came from your account. Sign in once on this device to use it here.
Tuvora’s own Continue Watching already includes what you play from this server. These are the server’s own shelves, off until you turn them on. Reorder or hide them under Appearance, then Homescreen.
Show as a row on Home
No movie or series libraries found.
Could not load the libraries right now.
Turn off to hide it from Home and search without removing it
Lets your other devices offer to sign in to this server. Only the address and username sync. Passwords and sign-in tokens never leave this device, so each device signs in on its own.
This device will be signed out of %1$s. The server stays in your list.
%1$s will be removed from your account and signed out on this device. Nothing on the server itself changes.
Also clear its Continue Watching and library items
A TV or another device shows a code when it asks to use Quick Connect. Type that code here to sign it in as you, without typing a password on a remote.
Sign in to a Jellyfin server on this device first. Only a signed-in Jellyfin server can approve a code.
Approved. The other device can finish signing in now.
The server does not know that code. It may have expired, so ask the other device for a new one.
This device is no longer signed in to that server. Sign in again first.
You watched further on your server. Continue at %1$s?
